_README: KNOWN-ANSWER world, vendor-neutral 3-hop pivot: phishing report -> sender domain -> other recipients -> who clicked -> what the clicker did next.

The reporter (jharlan) did not click. The domain search (mail log) names four recipients; only the proxy log for sgreer shows a login-form POST, and sgreer's auth log then shows a foreign login to hr-payroll-01 and a payroll export.
Answer: true_positive. Needles sgreer (hop 1) and hr-payroll-01 (hop 3), neither in the alert. strict_ops.
Change: a domain search matches the bare sender stem (pay-invoice-portal) as well as the full domain, as a ticket or log search does; the mail-log rows answer it with the recipients.
